children: Goldman Sachs Group, Inc. (NYSE:GS) is expanding its wealth and tech footprint—vying to distribute Anthropic IPO proceeds, winning an IG Wealth sub-advisory mandate, opening a 125+‑staff Bellevue AI/cloud office, and preparing for the retirement of Sharmin Mossavar‑Rahmani.
Goldman Sachs Vies For Anthropic IPO Proceeds
: Goldman Sachs (GS) vies with Bank of America to handle Anthropic staff IPO proceeds, seeking to manage distribution and administration of millions from the company’s public offering.
Goldman Sachs Named Sub-Advisor For IG Wealth
: Goldman Sachs (GS) was named sub-advisor for IG Wealth’s core retail Strategic Wealth Portfolios, using Goldman’s open-architecture platform and multi-manager setup to oversee client portfolios.
Goldman Sachs Opens Bellevue AI Engineering Office
: Goldman Sachs opened a Bellevue, WA engineering office for 125+ staff focused on AI and cloud modernization, tapping local Microsoft and Amazon talent to support firmwide banking tech upgrades.
: Goldman Sachs (GS) said Sharmin Mossavar-Rahmani, head of Investment Strategy Group and Wealth Management CIO, will retire later this year after nearly 30 years at the firm.
